help: raise a PR or an issue, the kind the first word - pr, from the issues it aims to complete, its title the first issue's verbatim copy and its why section one aim line per issue; issue, from its should and its relations, each wired as it is raised; the Signature and, for an issue, the as-at anchor stamped by the forge, so that no aim, no relation and no attribution is written by hand; the body file carries the drafter's sections alone

args.name: issue
args.help: pr - the issues the PR aims to complete, by number, the central one first; its title becomes the PR's

args.name: --head
args.help: pr - the branch the forge holds, pushed already

args.name: --title
args.help: issue - the should, in one sentence that carries the word and no issue number

args.name: --body
args.help: the body as drafted - a PR's what, how and to; an issue's currently with its as is, and its but, in future; it carries no Signature, no aim line, no as-at and no narrated relation, which the forge writes or wires

args.name: --blocked-by
args.help: issue - an open issue this one waits on, wired as it is raised; repeatable

args.name: --blocks
args.help: issue - an open issue that waits on this one, the parent of a part, wired as it is raised; repeatable

args.name: --supersedes
args.help: issue - the open issue this one replaces, closed as not planned with its relations transferred and the ledger note posted, in the one act

gh issue view: reads each named issue's state and title; a closed issue refuses the raise, and a PR's title is its first issue's
gh api: reads each aimed issue's open blockers (issues/482); an open blocker not aimed at refuses the raise, as it would the merge
reads the forge's main, its sha and subject, for an issue's as-at anchor
WRITES each blocked_by edge an issue is raised with, and the edges a superseded issue held, then reads the raised issue's edges back (refused loudly under CORPUS_YOGA_NO_SEND)
gh repo view: reads the default branch, the PR's base and the issue's anchor
gh pr create: WRITES the PR with the generated title and body (refused loudly under CORPUS_YOGA_NO_SEND)
gh issue create: WRITES the issue with its should as the title and the composed body (refused loudly under CORPUS_YOGA_NO_SEND)
gh issue close: WRITES the superseded issue closed as not planned, with the ledger note naming its successor, the room and the date (refused loudly under CORPUS_YOGA_NO_SEND)
